title: Add real Codex smoke gate
body:
## Summary
- Add Makefile targets for Codex runtime preflight and strict real-Codex smoke.
- Document the gate in onboarding and agent system docs.
- Improve Codex preflight classification when the CLI runtime itself fails.

## Validation
- Focused tests pass.
- make codex-preflight and make codex-smoke are currently blocked by the local Codex CLI installation missing its native vendor binary.
